analysts.as: Postquantum computing moves into action plans

expert.text: Finish discovery and an initial PQC plan by 2028, do priority migration by 2031, and complete migration by 2035.
All Member States should start PQC transition by end of 2026, moving high-risk use cases no later than end of 2030.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Ask every vendor for a post-quantum roadmap at renewal; EU states must start by end 2026.
lens.ciso: Start a cryptographic inventory this year; data stolen today can be decrypted later.
lens.cto: Design for crypto-agility so algorithms can be swapped without rebuilding systems.
lens.eng: Map where TLS, signing and key exchange are used, and prefer libraries with post-quantum options.

line: Today's encryption must be replaced before quantum computers can break it. Deadlines are set.
scope: Replacing today's encryption. Not quantum computers themselves.

sources.name: The White House
sources.title: Fact sheet: Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks

title: Post-quantum cryptography
why: EU states must start by the end of 2026 and protect high-risk uses by 2030.
US federal systems must move by 2030 or 2031; Google targets 2029.
Data stolen today can be decrypted once quantum machines arrive.
